exposure: Planned elective repeat cesarean section (ERCS) at 39-41 weeks gestation
outcome: Rate of spontaneous labor before 39 weeks
cohort: 32,934 women in New South Wales, Australia, from 2007-2010 who were planned to have an ERCS at 39-41 weeks gestation
finding: 8.5% of low-risk women planned for ERCS at 39-41 weeks gestation went into spontaneous labor before 39 weeks, with the risk varying depending on previous delivery history.
